attempts.summary: Built a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (mariadb-server 10.11 + galera-4) on node1/node2/node3, which started as plain Ubuntu 24.04 hosts with nothing preinstalled. Loaded application data, took the entire cluster down completely for a maintenance window, and brought it back up with all committed writes intact and all three members Synced/serving. Then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and full cluster/data recovery after each restart.
